items.title: INV-034/Q-021 goal-maintenance-agency (onboarded): C6 z_goal measurement-harness fix (run_p2 contact-gated peak)
items.note: Driver-only measurement-harness correction of V3-EXQ-866a (supersedes it). 866a's C6 (c6_pass=0, zgoal_norm_mean_FULL=0.1198) was a MEASUREMENT ARTIFACT: its _measure_866_style rolled its own P2 readout that called update_z_goal unconditionally every step and averaged ||z_goal||, so GoalState's per-step decay (decay_goal=0.005) washed z_goal to ~0.12 on the near-zero-contact P2 env. The substrate preserves z_goal through the whole curriculum (enters P2 ~0.52; the scheduler's own contact-gated run_p2 reports z_goal_norm_peak_max ~0.52 with n_decay_only=0). 866c keeps G0/C1-C5 identical to 866a (behavioral pass unchanged, bit-identical) and reads C6 from scheduler.run_p2's z_goal_norm_peak_max (restoring post-P1 z_goal before run_p2). C6 gates on peak_max NOT z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak: G0 fails (FULL forages below RANDOM), so contact is near-zero and contact_peak would spuriously fail C6 for a z_goal that IS maintained; peak_max is robust to that foraging confound (peak_max is the wanting-pathway-engagement readout, orthogonal to G0/C4). PRIMARY BLOCKER remains G0 (foraging-competence, GAP-2/Stage-H ceiling), reported honestly; NOT expected to PASS overall (G0 gates first). G0 routed separately to chip-20260808-g0-foraging-competence-autopsy; sibling V3-EXQ-899 is the G0-readiness re-run. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive contact-gated z_goal_norm_peak_max readout is not recorded on any compatible manifest (866a recorded only the decaying mean) -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): literal count=2 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-866 + _866a) but NOT braked -- 866 is substrate_not_ready_requeue (action=none, a re-run rec) and 866a is substrate_ceiling with action=none (no build owed, names the G0/Stage-H foraging path); the brake remedy (route /implement-substrate) is inapplicable and 866a's ceiling reading was partly driven by the very C6 artifact this fixes. USER-AUTHORIZED instrument-repair (decision chip chip-20260808-scaffolded-c6-misdiagnosis-routing option A, 2026-08-08); instrument-defect carve-out applies. DV-SYMMETRY: the FULL-vs-AVOIDANCE_ONLY ablation is a structural removal of the whole wanting pathway (z_goal presence + goal-conditioned per-candidate selection bias), NOT a broadcast scalar/monotone rescale/permutation -- it genuinely moves argmax/softmax selection, so no arm's DV is invariant under it. Diagnosis: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/scaffolded_curriculum_hazard_rebalance_diagnosis_staged_2026-08-08.md (REE_assembly 5521a31df5).
